build_dataset_cifar: build a CIFAR100 dataset with transforms for training or evaluation using build_dataset
build_dataset_imagenet: build an ImageFolder dataset from ImageNet train or val split using build_dataset
build_dataset_image_folder: build a custom ImageFolder dataset with a specified number of classes using build_dataset
build_transform_train: build a training transform pipeline with auto augmentation and random erasing using build_transform
build_transform_eval: build an evaluation transform pipeline with resizing and normalization using build_transform
